verdict.rationale: Poly's agent can automate file tasks such as organizing folders, and the docs describe flashback mode and recovery of any version of any file. Together these let a user roll back the effects of agent-made changes. The evidence covers file-level history only, not versioning or review of the automations themselves, and the community comment wanting git-style diffs is a wish rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: versioning of automation definitions, a review or diff step before or after an automation runs, rollback of an automation as a unit, and hands-on corroboration that recovery works for agent edits.
